'''Glenn Hall''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 100 from Beaverton, Or. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He was tournament director of the [[2003 Oregon State Championship]], held at the Willow Springs Apt. Community Center in Beaverton on 28 June 2003.<ref name="pc-us03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He ran regular [[Young Jedi]] CCG and SWCCG tournaments at the same community center in 2003.<ref name="pcf-622-9356" /><ref name="pcf-1955-30872" /> With [[Uriah Watkins]] he directed the 2004 Oregon State Championship there on 19 June 2004; thirteen players took part.<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" /><ref name="pcf-3383-47783" />
